locations.note: The tutorial sends the Spy and Thief into the German embassy to steal documents.
The Stalingrad campaign includes fighting around the recognisable Barmaley Fountain.
The commandos escape imprisonment in Berlin and pursue the officer who betrayed them.
The Normandy campaign culminates in an assault on the D-Day beach defences.
A Central Europe mission takes place aboard an armoured train at Saint-Avold.
Woolridge and Hancock clear a small town near Forbach so the Americans can ambush the German art convoy.
A Normandy mission infiltrates a German camp near Caen.
A mission at the port targets German E-boats.
O'Hara lands with the Americans on Omaha Beach, takes out the coastal artillery and clears the bunkers.

routes.name: Stalingrad campaign
routes.note: The commandos defend a Soviet command post at Stalingrad, are betrayed by General O'Donnell and flown to a Berlin prison, then escape to kill the traitor.

routes.name: Central Europe campaign
routes.note: Duchamp, Toledo and O'Hara seize an armoured train of looted art at Saint-Avold, and the convoy carrying the captives and the art is ambushed in a town near Forbach.

routes.name: Normandy campaign
routes.note: On the night before D-Day the commandos wreck a German reserve camp near Caen, mine E-boats in Le Havre at daybreak, and storm Omaha Beach with the Americans.
